Plug-in solar with battery storage is a small solar power system that plugs into a household outlet or powers appliances directly, with a battery to store excess solar energy for nighttime use.

There are three main types:

Type

	

How it works




Plug-in solar + battery

	

Solar panels charge a battery, which supplies electricity to your home through an approved connection




Portable solar generator

	

Panels charge a battery that powers appliances plugged directly into it




Grid-tied solar + storage

	

Permanently installed solar panels and battery connect to your home's electrical system

Popular examples include Anker SOLIX Solarbank and EcoFlow STREAM.

Important: Plugging a battery-backed solar inverter into an ordinary wall outlet to feed your home is not automatically legal or safe in the United States. Local electrical codes, utility interconnection requirements, and equipment certification matter.
